name: Poker Max
summary:
**This game is in early access. For the best experience and help finding a table, join our community on Discord at pokermaxvr.com/discord**

**We love VR.  We love Poker.** And we think that combination should be way better. 

So we’re building the game VR Poker players deserve.  A game that feels more like **poker night with your friends**, less like a glitchy casino simulator.

Welcome to the table, welcome to **Poker Max.**


**Poker only!** - We want to keep the main thing, **the main thing**.
